mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS is decreasing over the next 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a contraction in economic activity and reduced growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates robust economic activity and investor confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) when GDPC1 is increasing over the next 5 days.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust demand across sectors, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not positive when both GDPC1 and HOUST are rising over the next 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: A weakening labor market (falling UNRATE) combined with strong job growth (PAYEMS > 138,000) signals labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not positive when UNRATE falls below 4.5% and PAYEMS exceeds 138,000 over the next 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates stronger business activity and supply chain health, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) when INDPRO is increasing over the next 5 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), higher interest rates reduce growth prospects and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above previous month's value
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not negative in a tightening monetary regime.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in GDP (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust demand and supply alignment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not positive when both GDPC1 and INDPRO are rising over the next 60 days.
